content.description: This tote bag is made of 100% cotton with a fabric weight of 140 g/m². It measures 38 × 42 cm and offers a 10 L capacity. The 67 cm handles let you carry it by hand or over the shoulder, and the CutAway label is designed for ease of rebranding.
